title: Florida Dramatic Arrest: Defies Police, Resists Detainment and Threatens Violence!
description:
Loyd allegedly resisted the lawful orders of several identifiable law enforcement officers at the scene, struggling and attempting to pull away during his detainment.  Loyd’s defiant and combative behavior continued throughout his interaction with the police.

Upon his arrest, Loyd was found to be in possession of a small amount of cannabis and related paraphernalia. More charges were added post-arrest when Loyd, while receiving medical treatment, allegedly also made verbal threats against Officer Micciantuono, promising a violent confrontation if they were to meet in public.

Throughout the events at the hospital, Loyd displayed physically resistive behavior and refused to comply with the officers' instructions.
